title: Bigg Boss OTT 2 Star Jiya Shankar Gets Engaged to US-Based Entrepreneur Kaaran Dhanak
excerpt: Television actress Jiya Shankar announced her engagement to corporate professional Kaaran Dhanak with an emotional social media post about their long-distance love story.
body:
• Television and film actress Jiya Shankar announced her engagement to US-based entrepreneur and corporate professional Kaaran Dhanak on August 6
  • The couple maintained a long-distance relationship across continents before Dhanak proposed with a diamond ring
  • Shankar previously dismissed viral engagement rumours linking her to Bigg Boss OTT 2 co-contestant Abhishek Malhan
  • The engagement was accompanied by an emotional social media post detailing their love story and coordinated outdoor photos

Television actress Jiya Shankar, best known for her stint on Bigg Boss OTT 2 and her role in the series Kaatelal and Sons, announced her engagement to entrepreneur Kaaran Dhanak on August 6. Shankar shared a series of photographs and a lengthy, emotional note on social media, giving fans the first public confirmation of a relationship she had kept largely under wraps for months.

A Long-Distance Love Story Made Public

In her announcement post, Shankar described how her relationship with Dhanak — a corporate professional based in the United States — grew despite the physical distance between them. "Every conversation with you even though you were thousands of miles away from me, felt like home," she wrote.

The actress, who has built a significant following through television and reality TV, reflected on the difficulties of maintaining a cross-border relationship while navigating a demanding career in Mumbai's entertainment industry. "This journey wasn't easy but we chose each other every single day," she wrote. "You showed me the love I waited my whole life for. You made me laugh on my toughest days."

"Held me a lil tighter every time at airport goodbyes like your heart was breaking into a thousand pieces."

— Jiya Shankar, in her engagement announcement post

Shankar affectionately referred to Dhanak as her "goofball," "best friend" and "ABCD" — a term that drew particular attention from fans, commonly used to describe American-Born Confused Desi individuals of Indian heritage raised abroad. The photographs showed the couple sharing a kiss, walking hand in hand, and posing in coordinated pastel outfits against a lush outdoor backdrop.

Putting the Abhishek Malhan Rumours to Rest

The engagement puts a definitive end to persistent rumours that had linked Shankar romantically with her Bigg Boss OTT 2 co-contestant Abhishek Malhan, the YouTube creator also known as Fukra Insaan. Their visible chemistry on the reality show had fuelled speculation about a potential relationship, which both consistently denied.

In late December 2025, reports surfaced claiming Shankar and Malhan were planning to get engaged. Shankar responded by posting a photograph of herself with a mystery man — later identified by fans as Dhanak — along with a pointed caption: "Let's leave false rumours in 2025!" Malhan also publicly dismissed the speculation.

According to a report by Bollywood Shaadis, Shankar had been dating Dhanak for several months prior to the public announcement. Dhanak is reportedly an entrepreneur and corporate professional based in the United States, though specific details about his business ventures remain limited.

What Comes Next for Shankar

On the professional front, Shankar has been active across television, music videos, and brand collaborations since her Bigg Boss OTT 2 appearance in 2023 raised her national profile. She was also part of the reality show Engaged Season 2 on JioHotstar alongside Elvish Yadav earlier this year.

Neither Shankar nor Dhanak have announced wedding plans. Shankar's post concluded with a forward-looking note: "Life is definitely an adventure with you and it happens to be my favourite rom-com. I can't wait to spend my forever with you and spend the rest of my life loving you the way you've always loved me."

The engagement announcement drew an outpouring of congratulations from fellow television and film personalities, with fans celebrating the resolution of months of speculation about Shankar's personal life.
nri_angle: Shankar's engagement to US-based entrepreneur Kaaran Dhanak, whom she calls her 'ABCD,' resonates with diaspora audiences familiar with cross-border Indian relationships.
